verdict.rationale: Lowenstein Sandler is a law firm whose digital offering is the Clerky formation-workflow partnership. A firm like this could plausibly ship a client-facing AI assistant, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack shows a built-in AI assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The Clerky workflows use standardized documentation rather than an AI agent, and the llms.txt file is a machine-readable site summary, not an in-product assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
